wedo_instance.description: Plan for enhancing the agent bootup experience and enforcing forensic metabolic logging.

meta.philosophy: Frictionless Incarnation: Reducing the latency between agent birth and high-value work while maintaining absolute forensic integrity.

rules.metabolic_logging: Use 'py/metagit_commit.py' in the meta-root to regularly log state changes (minimum once per significant task block).
rules.automated_anchoring: The 'register_agent.py' script MUST automatically handle session_env.json synchronization to prevent identity drift.
rules.rna_presumption: All process artifacts (like this WeDo) MUST reside in '.hidden/' subdirectories.

tasks.description: Automated Drift Correction: Update 'register_agent.py' to automatically overwrite 'session_env.json' with the new agent identity, eliminating the need for manual 'Euthymius' corrections.
Metabolic Trigger: Integrate a 'metagit_commit' call directly into the handover process to ensure the previous agent's final state is always locked in.
Log Enforcer: Establish a 'Metabolic Heartbeat' rule requiring a MetaGit commit after every 3 significant tool calls.
Context Pree-fetch: Enhance bootup to automatically deep-read the latest Handover and WeDo JSONs to populate the 'Active Mission' without user prompting.
